title: Home Office Coffee Budget Policy
content:
# Home Office Coffee Budget Policy

All team members are eligible for a **$30/month** coffee and tea budget, reimbursable via Navan. Receipts are required for any single purchase over $20. The budget does not roll over between months.

title: Home Office Snack Budget Policy
content:
# Home Office Snack Budget Policy

Team members receive a **$50/month** snack stipend. Combined with the coffee budget, total food-related home office reimbursement is capped at $80/month.

title: #ops-announcements — coffee budget bump
content: @channel — effective **March 15, 2026** we're raising the home office coffee budget from $30 to **$45/month**, confirmed by Ops (HR-validated). The snack stipend ($50) is unchanged. The handbook page is out of date — I'll open an MR this week.
